script.text: The Signers failed to defeat all of the Dark Signers before sunset, and the King of the Netherworld arose.
Yusei and the other Signers were transported by the Crimson Dragon to Rex Goodwin's location.
Isn’t this the temple underneath Goodwin’s mansion?
The King of the Netherworld is heading this way... but what for?
In that case, allow me to explain.
You may have succeeded in defeating the Dark Signers, but not in time to close the doors to the Netherworld.
The King of the Netherworld is coming here for the ritual.
The ritual that has been carried out at this temple for many millennia.
This ritual duel will allow me to become all-powerful and rule the world!
I will crush you Signers and send you all to the Netherworld!
In turn, the King of the Netherworld will do my bidding, and my ultimate plan will at last be set in motion.
Now then, will you agree to this duel...or will you not?
Sure – if beating you means that monster goes bye-bye!
Sounds fair to me. But you wretched Signers are the ones who’ll be getting the beating!
